title: Platform deviations
description: Layer 1 schema for one platform manifest extensions/deviations/ file: the places where a platform cannot match a component's foundation recipe, one component per file. A renderer never reads it. See spec/manifest.md#extensionsdeviations.

component.description: Name of the component (foundation or platform-local) the deviations are about. Resolves directly or through `componentAliases` (SPEC-110).

deviations.description: The deviations. `id` is unique within the file (SPEC-109).

id.description: Slug that names the deviation in reports. Unique within the file.

part.description: An anatomy part of the component. Absent means any part.

property.description: A visual property (stroke, fill, color, fontFamily, ...). Absent means the deviation is documentation only: tools list it but match nothing against it.

status.description: `accepted`: the platform will not match the recipe. `planned`: it expects to, once the blocker (see `upstream`) is gone.

reason.description: Why the platform cannot match the recipe.

upstream.description: Link to the issue that blocks the platform.

tolerance.description: Largest difference a tool treats as the deviation (same unit as the property's comparison).

condition.description: Where the deviation applies: the recipe condition shape without `position`. An absent key means any.
